description: This file defines the 'Grade' entity class for the Learning Management System backend, representing a grade record with fields for submission, grader, points, feedback, and timestamp. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Grade
classes.description: Entity class for storing grade information associated with a submission and grader, including points, feedback, and timestamp.

methods.name: Grade()
methods.description: Protected default constructor required by JPA.

methods.name: Grade(Long submissionId, Long graderId, int points, String feedback)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Grade object with specified submission ID, grader ID, points awarded, and feedback.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the grade record.

methods.name: getSubmissionId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the submission associated with this grade.

methods.name: getGraderId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the grader who graded the submission.

methods.name: getFeedback()
methods.description: Returns the feedback string provided by the grader.

methods.name: getGradedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the grade was assigned.
